Cenote Scout.notes: Body with ETB explore: conditional land access into hand and selection of a nonland. This is not an unconditional draw spell.

Elfhame Wurm.notes: Vigilance/trample body; intrinsic combat keywords do not count as an independent combat trick.

Evolving Adaptive.notes: Growing body; its self-growth does not supply an independent pump spell or hidden removal.

Flourishing Bloom-Kin.notes: Body, with conditional Forest search and deployment after being turned face up. Role presence does not imply that route is immediately usable from hand.

Forest.notes: Ordinary land access. A normal land drop is not additional mana acceleration.

Hazard of the Dunes.notes: Body with an on-board self-boost. Do not interpret holding this creature as holding a separate combat trick.

Hulking Raptor.notes: Body with recurring precombat mana. Its own ward is not a protection spell for another permanent or a counterspell in hand.

Ichorspit Basilisk.notes: Deathtouch/toxic body; combat keywords do not constitute a standalone removal or direct burn spell.

Pugnacious Hammerskull.notes: Creature presence with an attack condition, not hidden independent interaction.

Llanowar Elves.notes: Creature plus tap-for-mana capability; summoning sickness can delay mana production.

Brazen Borrower.notes: Flash creature and bounce Adventure. Available routes depend on zone; bounce is temporary rather than permanent spot removal.

Boseiju, Who Endures.notes: Land plus channel destruction of an opposing artifact, enchantment or nonbasic land; not a creature answer.

Counterspell.notes: Counters a spell, not an activated ability or land play.

Growth Spiral.notes: One-card replacement and conditional additional land deployment; requires an eligible land to accelerate.

Lightning Bolt.notes: Three damage to any target, supplying conditional creature removal or direct reach. One physical card is counted once in each role.

Wrath of God.notes: Mass creature destruction, not an individually targeted removal route.

Ajani, Nacatl Avenger.notes: Transformed planeswalker face of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah; only reachable from the battlefield, never held in hand.

Ajani, Nacatl Pariah.notes: Human body plus a 2/1 non-Human Cat Warrior token: one card supplies both halves of a Winota trigger. Transforms when another Cat dies.

Alexios, Deimos of Kosmos.notes: Trampling non-Human that changes control each upkeep and must attack; pressure and a Winota trigger rather than a stable blocker.

Alseid of Life's Bounty.notes: Lifelink non-Human one-drop that sacrifices to give protection from a colour to a creature or enchantment.

Angrath's Marauders.notes: Non-Human body that doubles all damage its controller's sources deal.

Arcane Denial.notes: Hard counter; both players draw later.

Arcane Signet.notes: Mana rock for the commander's colours.

Archon of Emeria.notes: Flying non-Human; one spell per turn for each player and opposing nonbasic lands enter tapped.

Armored Scrapgorger.notes: Mana creature that exiles a graveyard card each time it taps.

Auratouched Mage.notes: Human that fetches an Aura (here Breath of Fury) onto itself.

Avalanche of Sector 7.notes: Menace non-Human whose power is the opponent's artifact count, and pings an opponent who activates artifact abilities.

Aven Interrupter.notes: Flash flier that exiles a spell as plotted (a delay, not a counter) and taxes casting from graveyard or exile.

Aven Mindcensor.notes: Flash flier that limits opposing library searches to the top four cards.

Basalt Monolith.notes: Three-mana rock; with Kinnan it untaps for net infinite colourless mana.

Beast Within.notes: Destroys any permanent; its controller gets a 3/3 Beast.

Benevolent Bodyguard.notes: Human one-drop that sacrifices to give a creature protection from a colour.

Blade Historian.notes: Human that gives attacking creatures double strike.

Blinkmoth Nexus.notes: Colourless land that becomes a 1/1 flying non-Human artifact creature.

Bloom Tender.notes: Mana per colour among its controller's permanents; combo piece with Freed from the Real.

Boromir, Warden of the Tower.notes: Human; counters opposing spells cast without mana and sacrifices to make the team indestructible.

Bounding Krasis.notes: Substitute for Tidus, Zanarkand Fayth (not in this XMage build). Flash body that taps or untaps a creature.

Breath of Fury.notes: Aura that sacrifices the creature after combat damage to a player for an untap and an extra combat.

Breeding Pool.notes: Substitute for Avatar Sanctuary (not in this XMage build). Green-blue shockland.

Captain of the Watch.notes: Human that makes three Soldier tokens and pumps Soldiers.

Cathar Commando.notes: Flash Human that sacrifices to destroy an artifact or enchantment.

Chance for Glory.notes: Team indestructible and an extra turn; that turn's end step loses the game, so it is an all-in finisher.

Charitable Levy.notes: Taxes noncreature spells by one; after three noncreature spells it cashes in for a card and a Plains.

Clarion Conqueror.notes: Flying non-Human that shuts off activated abilities of artifacts, creatures and planeswalkers (mana rocks and dorks included).

Cliffside Rescuer.notes: Vigilant non-Human that sacrifices to protect a permanent from opponents.

Colossal Skyturtle.notes: Big flying ward body; channel returns a graveyard card or bounces a creature.

Combat Celebrant.notes: Human that exerts for an untap and an additional combat phase.

Dauntless Dismantler.notes: Human; opposing artifacts enter tapped, and it sacrifices to destroy every artifact of one mana value.

Deafening Silence.notes: One noncreature spell per turn for each player.

Devoted Druid.notes: Mana creature that untaps with -1/-1 counters; combo piece.

Drift of Phantasms.notes: Flying defender; transmute finds a mana-value-3 card (Basalt Monolith, Bloom Tender...).

Eidolon of Rhetoric.notes: Enchantment creature: one spell per turn for each player.

Enduring Vitality.notes: Creatures tap for any colour; returns as an enchantment when it dies.

Eomer, King of Rohan.notes: Double-strike Human that grows with Humans, makes a player the monarch and deals its power to any target on entry.

Eternal Witness.notes: Returns a graveyard card to hand.

Ethersworn Canonist.notes: Non-Human artifact creature: one nonartifact spell per turn for each player.

Exotic Orchard.notes: Land making colours the opponent's lands make.

Explore the Vastlands.notes: Adventure-side spell of Wandering Archaic: each player digs for lands/instants/sorceries and gains 3 life.

Fabricate.notes: Finds an artifact (Basalt Monolith, Sol Ring...).

Fellwar Stone.notes: Mana rock for colours the opponent's lands make.

Flamescroll Celebrant.notes: MDFC: a Human that pings opponents for non-mana activations, or Revel in Silence (no spells or loyalty abilities for opponents this turn).

Freed from the Real.notes: Aura that taps and untaps a creature for {U}; infinite mana with Bloom Tender or Devoted Druid-style dorks.

Gene Pollinator.notes: Mana creature that taps another permanent.

Gingerbrute.notes: Hasty non-Human artifact creature with conditional evasion; sacrifices for life.

Giver of Runes.notes: Repeatable protection from colourless or a colour for another creature.

Goblin Rabblemaster.notes: Non-Human that makes a hasty Goblin token each combat; Goblins must attack.

Goblin Token.notes: 1/1 red Goblin, a non-Human Winota trigger.

Goldhound.notes: First-strike menace non-Human one-drop that sacrifices for one mana.

Grand Abolisher.notes: Human: opponents cannot cast spells or activate artifact/creature/enchantment abilities during its controller's turn.

High Noon.notes: One spell per turn for each player; sacrifices for 5 damage to any target.

Hope of Ghirapur.notes: Flying non-Human artifact one-drop; after combat damage it sacrifices to stop that player casting noncreature spells.

Howlsquad Heavy.notes: Non-Human that makes a Goblin token each combat and gives Goblins haste; mana at max speed.

Hullbreaker Horror.notes: Uncounterable flash body; each own spell bounces a spell or nonland permanent.

Hushbringer.notes: Flying lifelink non-Human; creatures entering or dying trigger nothing (Winota triggers on attack, so it is unaffected).

Incubation Druid.notes: Mana creature; three mana once it has a counter.

Intruder Alarm.notes: Creatures do not untap normally; any creature entering untaps all: combo engine with mana creatures and tokens.

Jor Kadeen, the Prevailer.notes: Human; with metalcraft the team gets +3/+0.

Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy.notes: Commander. Nonland mana permanents make an extra mana; {5}{G}{U} puts a non-Human creature from the top five onto the battlefield.

Legion Warboss.notes: Non-Human; makes a hasty attacking Goblin each combat and mentors.

Lena, Selfless Champion.notes: Human that makes a Soldier per nontoken creature and sacrifices to make smaller creatures indestructible.

Leyline of Abundance.notes: Creatures tapped for mana make an extra {G}; can start on the battlefield; late-game team pump.

Loyal Apprentice.notes: Hasty Human; with the commander out it makes a hasty flying Thopter each combat.

Machine God's Effigy.notes: Mana artifact that can enter as a copy of any creature.

Mana Leak.notes: Soft counter: unless its controller pays three.

March of Swirling Mist.notes: Phases out up to X creatures: protects its own or removes blockers/attackers for a turn.

Memnite.notes: Free non-Human artifact creature: a zero-mana Winota trigger.

Mirage Mirror.notes: Becomes a copy of an artifact, creature, enchantment or land until end of turn.

Mirage Phalanx.notes: Human with soulbond that copies itself and its partner each combat.

Miscast.notes: Counters an instant or sorcery unless its controller pays three.

Mishra's Factory.notes: Colourless land that becomes a 2/2 non-Human artifact creature.

Moonsilver Key.notes: Finds a mana artifact or a basic land.

Muddle the Mixture.notes: Counters an instant or sorcery; transmute finds a mana-value-2 card.

Murkfiend Liege.notes: Anthem for green and blue creatures that untap on the opponent's untap step.

Narset, Parter of Veils.notes: Planeswalker: opponents draw one card per turn; -2 digs for a noncreature, nonland card.

Nature's Rhythm.notes: Puts a creature of mana value X or less from library onto the battlefield; harmonize recasts it.

Neoform.notes: Sacrifices a creature to put one with one more mana value onto the battlefield.

Nyxbloom Ancient.notes: Triples mana from permanents; trample body.

Paradise Druid.notes: Mana creature with hexproof while untapped.

Pemmin's Aura.notes: Aura that untaps for {U} (combo with Kinnan/Bloom Tender), grants shroud, flying or stat shifts.

Perplexing Chimera.notes: Exchanges itself for an opponent's spell: steals that spell.

Phoenix Chick.notes: Hasty flying non-Human; returns from the graveyard attacking when three or more creatures attack.

Phyrexian Revoker.notes: Non-Human artifact creature that names a card whose activated abilities stop working.

Pia and Kiran Nalaar.notes: Human pair making two Thopter tokens; sacrifices artifacts for 2 damage to any target.

Poison Dart Frog.notes: Reach mana creature that can gain deathtouch.

Professional Face-Breaker.notes: Human; combat damage makes Treasure, and Treasure becomes impulse draws.

Prophet of Distortion.notes: Body with a colourless-mana draw outlet.

Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer.notes: Substitute for Mayor Tong of Chin Village (not in this XMage build). Non-Human one-drop with dash; combat damage makes Treasure and steals a card.

Razorgrass Ambush.notes: MDFC: 3 damage to an attacking or blocking creature, or the land Razorgrass Field.

Reality Shift.notes: Exiles a creature; its controller manifests a 2/2.

Reclamation Sage.notes: Body that destroys an artifact or enchantment.

Regrowth.notes: Returns a graveyard card to hand.

Revel in Silence.notes: Back face of Flamescroll Celebrant: opponents cannot cast spells or activate loyalty abilities this turn.

Rionya, Fire Dancer.notes: Human that makes hasty token copies of another creature each combat.

Samurai of the Pale Curtain.notes: Human; permanents that would go to a graveyard are exiled instead.

Sanctum Prelate.notes: Human that forbids noncreature spells of a chosen mana value.

Seedborn Muse.notes: Untaps its controller's permanents on each other player's untap step.

Signal Pest.notes: Non-Human artifact one-drop with battle cry and evasion.

Silence.notes: Opponents cannot cast spells this turn: protects a combo or alpha strike.

Skrelv, Defector Mite.notes: Non-Human artifact one-drop giving hexproof from a colour, toxic and evasion.

Skyclave Apparition.notes: Exiles a nonland, nontoken permanent of mana value 4 or less; the owner gets an Illusion if it leaves.

Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance.notes: Legendary Mountain; channel makes two hasty Spirit tokens.

Soldier Token.notes: 1/1 Soldier token; not a Human, so it triggers Winota when it attacks.

Soulless Jailer.notes: Non-Human artifact creature: no permanents from graveyards, no noncreature casts from graveyard or exile.

Spell Pierce.notes: Noncreature spell unless its controller pays two.

Spirit of the Labyrinth.notes: Each player draws at most one card per turn.

Springleaf Drum.notes: Taps a creature for any colour; mana permanent for Kinnan.

Sundering Eruption.notes: MDFC: destroys a land (its controller may fetch a basic) and grounders cannot block; or the land Volcanic Fissure.

Swords to Plowshares.notes: One-mana creature exile; its controller gains life.

Thalia, Guardian of Thraben.notes: First-strike Human; noncreature spells cost one more.

The Wandering Rescuer.notes: Flash convoke double-strike Human; other tapped creatures (attackers) have hexproof.

Thopter Token.notes: 1/1 flying Thopter, a non-Human Winota trigger.

Thorn Mammoth.notes: Fights an opposing creature whenever it or another own creature enters.

Tidespout Tyrant.notes: Flying body; every own spell bounces a permanent.

Touch the Spirit Realm.notes: Exiles an artifact or creature while it remains; channel flickers one (removal-lite or protection).

Treasure Token.notes: Sacrifice for one mana of any colour.

Treasure Vault.notes: Land that cashes in for X Treasure.

Unstoppable Plan.notes: Untaps all its controller's nonland permanents at its end step.

Urn of Godfire.notes: Filter rock that later destroys a creature or enchantment.

Volatile Stormdrake.notes: Flier that exchanges itself for an opposing creature; that creature is sacrificed unless energy pays for it.

Walking Ballista.notes: Counter-based pinger; with infinite mana it is a finisher.

Wandering Archaic.notes: MDFC/adventure body that copies opposing instants and sorceries unless they pay two.

Waterlogged Grove.notes: Painland for green and blue that cashes in for a card.

Winota, Joiner of Forces.notes: Commander. Each non-Human attacker digs six cards and puts a Human onto the battlefield attacking and indestructible: the deck's central engine.

Yuffie, Materia Hunter.notes: Human with ninjutsu that steals a noncreature artifact while it stays.
